senses.gloss: स-फल- + प्रार्थन स-फल- + प्रार्थन, adj. one who has attained his desire, Vikr. d. 27.
स- + फल स- + फल, adj. 1. bearing fruit, Hit. i. d. 10, M.M.; rewarded, Vikr. 10, 9; fulfilled, Vikr. d. 27. 2. yielding a profit. 3. blessed, Rājat. 5, 373.

शफ शफ, m. and n.
 1. A hoof in general, Man. 10, 89.
 2. A horse's hoof.
 3. The root of a tree.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. O.H.G. huof; A.S. hóf, The hoof of a horse.
शफर शफ + र, and सफर सफर, m., and f. री, A small fish, Cyprinus Sophore, Pañc. ii. d. 87 (र); Bhartṛ. 3, 94 (री).
सफर सफर, see शप्कर; सफल सफल, see स-फल.

साफल्य साफल्य, i. e. स-फल + य, n.
 1. Productiveness, fruitfulness, Hit. ii. d. 21.
 2. Advantage, Man. 12, 93.
 3. State of earning the fruit, Mālat. 72, 9 (at the end of a Bahuvr.).
